peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the difference between Stx1 and Stx2?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Stx1 is almost completely cell associated, whereas Stx2 is found in the extracellular fraction (35, 39). This difference in distribution is due to the different translocations across the outer membrane in EHEC, because Stx1 is located in the periplasmic fraction of the bacterial cells (51) (Fig. 1).
